verdict.rationale: Fellow's docs say every meeting automatically gets a clear summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes (fellow-docs-23, fellow-docs-51, fellow-docs-52). A webhook fires when an AI note is generated, which implies the summary arrives promptly after the meeting (fellow-docs-46). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that summaries are good enough to share without editing, documented sharing/distribution of the recap, and explicit post-meeting delivery timing.
